description: The bar chart in Figure 7 illustrates the number of questions, out of 40, where the Chain of Thought (CoT) generated by GPT3 using different methods contains at least one factual error. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled with three different methods: NoR, OneR, and IRCoT, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The bars represent the number of questions with at least one factual error for each method, with NoR having the tallest bar at approximately 63.8, OneR at around 31.3, and IRCoT at about 29.9. The bars are colored according to their respective labels, with NoR being white, OneR being red, and IRCoT being blue. The bars are not sorted in any particular order other than the categorical order on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
